description: Surface candidate-recipe reports when ≥10 instances of the same manual edit pattern are observed; recipe authoring remains human-in-the-loop and is never auto-generated.

requirements.description: Cartographer must surface candidate-recipe reports when ≥10 instances of the same manual edit pattern are observed in analytics override history. The report must identify the pattern, its frequency, representative examples, and a suggested recipe name. Recipe authoring must remain human-in-the-loop; the pipeline must never auto-generate or auto-apply recipes.
requirements.title: Recipe Identification Pipeline — Candidate Report from Override History

validation.notes: Pattern frequency counter correctly groups override events by edit pattern type and counts instances
Report is only generated for patterns with ≥10 confirmed instances; patterns with <10 instances are omitted
Report output is clearly labeled as 'candidate — human authoring required' and contains no executable recipe code
Seed analytics with 12 override events of the same pattern type; arch-cart recipes identify surfaces a candidate report for that pattern
Seed analytics with 9 override events of the same pattern type; arch-cart recipes identify produces no output for that pattern
Recipe authors can use the candidate report as a starting specification without reverse-engineering the override history manually
No candidate recipe is ever auto-applied or auto-committed

title: Recipe Identification Pipeline
